source: v2 naturalness/continuity revision; v1 and v2 preserved.

story.title: Pilot: The Little Seed
story.logline: When Toby finds a tiny seed, his friends use their unique talents to help it grow, learning that patience and gentle care make magic happen.
story.moral: Even the smallest seeds need time, care, and kindness to grow into something wonderful.

scenes.title: The Old Oak Gathering
scenes.summary: The friends share snacks under the Old Oak. Toby spots a tiny seed near the garden, and everyone has an idea about what it might become.
scenes.action: Wide shot of the six friends on the tree roots, sharing snacks. Toby crouches to inspect the seed. Close-up of the tiny seed in his palm.
scenes.camera: Warm, sunny wide shot, then a gentle push-in to the seed.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Under the Old Oak, the leaves made a soft, rustling sound.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Six friends gathered in the shade with snacks to share.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: I brought apple slices. They're cut into little moons.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I brought carrot sticks! Crunchy, crunchy carrot sticks!

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: Thank you, Pip. Let's share them together.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I brought my new drawing. It's a garden with a giant sunflower.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: A giant sunflower? Imagine standing under it!

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: I'd need a giant hat!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Everyone laughed. Then Toby noticed something small by the path.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Look. There's a tiny seed.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: A seed! It looks like a little brown pebble.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Maybe it will grow into a flower.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Or a carrot! A giant, crunchy carrot!

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: It might. Every seed is a little mystery.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: A mystery seed! We should sing to it.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Should we plant it?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Yes! Let's find a safe, sunny spot in the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The friends carried the seed to the garden, walking slowly and carefully.

scenes.title: Watering Wishes
scenes.summary: The friends plant the seed. Pip is a little too enthusiastic with the water, and Bruno teaches gentle care.
scenes.action: Mira shows her handmade watering can. Pip pours a big splash and makes a puddle. Bruno checks the soil. Toby looks worried. Pip practices a tiny splash.
scenes.camera: Playful medium shots with exaggerated water splashes, then a calm close-up of the soil.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: In the garden, the friends made a little home for the seed.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I made this watering can from a bottle and a spout. It's perfect for tiny seeds.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Let me water it! Splash! Splash! Splash!

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: Gently, Pip. A little water is enough.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: But seeds love water! Maybe it wants a big drink.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: The soil is getting very wet.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Oops! There's a puddle.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Oh! I didn't mean to make a puddle.

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: That's all right. We can fix it. Let's wait for the water to soak in.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: The seed is having a bath!

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Will it be okay?

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: Yes. We'll give it just a little water each day.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: And sunshine. Plants need sunshine too.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I can be the water helper. Gentle splashes only.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Pip practiced a tiny splash. The friends laughed, and the seed sat quietly in the soft, damp soil.

scenes.title: The Waiting Game
scenes.summary: The friends make a plan, a marker and a waiting song. Days pass, and Toby learns that some things grow slowly.
scenes.action: The group arranges a marker beside the seed. Morning and evening care montage: watering, sunshine, rain, singing. Toby places a small pebble beside the marker.
scenes.camera: Cosy close-ups of the marker and soil, then a gentle time-lapse of the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The next morning, the friends came back to check on the seed.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: It's still just soil.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Seeds are shy. They need time to wake up.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Maybe it's sleeping. Shhh!

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: Let's make a plan. We can water gently, give it sunshine, and check every morning.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I'll make a marker so we remember where we planted it.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: I'll bring my little watering cup.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I'll bring the gentle splashes!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: I'll draw a picture of what it might become.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: And I'll sing the waiting song!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: So the friends took turns. Morning after morning, they watered, watched, and sang.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Grow, little seed, grow. We're waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Waiting, waiting, patiently... that's the waiting song!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Some days the sun was warm. Some days the rain patted the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: And still, the friends waited.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Is it ever going to wake up?

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: Not forever. Some things grow slowly. We can be patient together.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Toby nodded and placed a tiny pebble beside the marker.

scenes.title: A Tiny Miracle
scenes.summary: A tiny green sprout appears. The friends celebrate quietly and promise to keep caring for it.
scenes.action: Macro shot of the sprout pushing through the soil. The friends gather around, delighted. Closing wide shot under the Old Oak at golden hour.
scenes.camera: Soft macro shot, then a warm group shot and a gentle pull-back to the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: Then, one morning, Toby saw something new.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Look! The soil is moving!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: A tiny green sprout!

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: It's pushing up through the soil!

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: It's so little! Hello, little sprout!

dialogue.speaker: Bruno
dialogue.text: It grew because we cared for it gently.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: And because we sang to it!

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: It's beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: The friends sat quietly and watched the little sprout in the sunshine.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: We can keep caring for it. Every day.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Imagine how big it'll be one day. Maybe as tall as the Old Oak!

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I'll give it gentle splashes.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: And I'll sing the growing song!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: So the friends learned that even the smallest seed needs time, care, and kindness to grow.

dialogue.speaker: Toby
dialogue.text: Grow, little seed, grow!

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Grow, grow, grow!

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Grow, little seed, grow!

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.text: And under the Old Oak, the little garden was full of hope.

changelog: Replaced formal phrasing with preschool-natural contractions.
Changed 'shivery sound' to 'rustling sound' for clarity and safety.
Replaced the unsupported 'All' speaker with Toby, Pip and Ollie lines.
Strengthened Leo's finale contribution with an imagination beat.
